title: IoT-Oriented Security for Small Sensor Systems Using DnCNN Denoising and Multimodal Feature Fusion for Image Forgery Detection
decisive_audit_evidence: Sections 3.1 and 6.1 and Table 2 evaluate CASIA 2.0 for conventional splicing, copy-move, and compositing detection/localization; Section 6.2 identifies GenImage and diffusion-era evaluation only as future work.

title: Copy-Move Forgery Detection (CMFD) Using Deep Learning for Image and Video Forensics
decisive_audit_evidence: Section 3 and Tables 3-5 evaluate eight open-access classical copy-move datasets; Sections 4.1 and 6 define and assess only copy-move forgery detection.

title: Aperture: A Patch-Aware Framework for Joint Forgery Detection and Localization
decisive_audit_evidence: Training/localization use the DDL collection of roughly 1.5 million single-face and multi-face tampering images across 61 facial-manipulation techniques; detection tests use face-deepfake benchmarks such as FaceForensics++, Celeb-DF, and DeeperForensics.

title: On Attribution of Deepfakes
decisive_audit_evidence: The attribution experiment uses 6,000 centered 1024x1024 human-face images, 2,000 each from ProgressiveGAN, StyleGAN, and StyleGAN2, and performs seed/source reconstruction and attribution.

title: Diffusion Models as a Representation Learner for Deepfake Image Detection
decisive_audit_evidence: The primary proceedings experiment reports classification on FaceForensics++ using DDIM reconstructions, latent inversion, and high-frequency features.

title: An Improved Dense CNN Architecture for Deepfake Image Detection
decisive_audit_evidence: The full paper uses real CelebA/FFHQ faces and fake faces from GDWCT, AttGAN, StarGAN, StyleGAN, and StyleGAN2; external testing extracts/crops faces from Celeb-DF video.

title: SpectraGuard: Provably-Private Deepfake Detection with Learnable Frequency-Domain Differential Privacy
decisive_audit_evidence: Detection/privacy experiments use FaceForensics++ and Celeb-DF, including reconstruction attacks against protected facial inputs.

title: Comparative Analysis of Deepfake Image Detection Method Using VGG16, VGG19 and ResNet50
decisive_audit_evidence: The study classifies 1,200 images, split between 600 real images and 600 FaceApp-manipulated face images, using VGG16, VGG19, and ResNet50.

title: Enhancing Deepfake Detection with Diversified Self-Blending Images and Residuals
decisive_audit_evidence: Training uses diversified self-blended facial images; cross-dataset tests train on FaceForensics++ and evaluate FaceForensics++ HQ/LQ, Celeb-DF, and WildDeepfake.

title: The Face Deepfake Detection Challenge
decisive_audit_evidence: Challenge tasks are face-deepfake detection and source-face reconstruction. Real data come from CelebA and FFHQ; fake faces come from StarGAN, StarGAN-v2, StyleGAN, StyleGAN2, AttGAN, and GDWCT, with additional face crops from DFDC/FaceForensics++ in participant development.

title: Deep Learning for Deepfakes Creation and Detection: A Survey
decisive_audit_evidence: The survey organizes image and video deepfake creation/detection around face synthesis, identity replacement, reenactment, facial attributes/artifacts, and face/video benchmarks such as FaceForensics++, Celeb-DF, DFDC, UADFV, and DeepfakeTIMIT.

title: Complement Face Forensic Detection and Localization with FacialLandmarks
decisive_audit_evidence: The proposed 1.3-million-image dataset uses CelebA/FFHQ real faces, DCGAN/LSGAN/BEGAN/WGAN-GP/ProGAN/StyleGAN generated faces, and StarGAN/SEFCGAN edited faces; external tests use FaceForensics++.

title: Beyond Backbones: Degradation-Aware Prototype Fusion for Robust Deepfake Detection
decisive_audit_evidence: The method is trained/evaluated on the NTIRE 2026 Robust Deepfake Detection face-forgery benchmark, with 26 image degradations and AUC as the principal metric.

title: LADLE-MM: Limited Annotation Based Detector with Learned Ensembles for Multimodal Misinformation
decisive_audit_evidence: DGM4 binary/multi-label experiments classify pristine/tampered image-text pairs with visual labels Face Swap and Face Attribute plus Text Swap and Text Attribute; VERITE tests open-set multimodal misinformation/out-of-context consistency rather than synthetic-image authenticity.

title: Deepfake detection using deep learning methods: A systematic and comprehensive review
decisive_audit_evidence: The systematic review categorizes deepfake detection into image, video, audio, and hybrid media, with its visual evidence centered on facial synthesis/manipulation, face replacement/reenactment, and established face/video deepfake datasets; it reports that video dominates the included literature.

title: Detecting fake images by identifying potential texture difference
decisive_audit_evidence: The primary paper defines Deepfake as face manipulation/replacement and evaluates ResNet18 classification after saliency-guided texture enhancement on real and fake face images.

title: Detection of real-time deep fakes and face forgery in video conferencing employing generative adversarial networks
decisive_audit_evidence: The full open primary article trains on CelebA-HQ faces and FaceForensics++ video frames for real-time video-conferencing face-forgery detection.

title: A Guided-Based Approach for Deepfake Detection: RGB-Depth Integration via Features Fusion
decisive_audit_evidence: The full primary paper crops subject faces and evaluates on FaceForensics++ videos covering DeepFakes, Face2Face, FaceSwap, and NeuralTextures facial manipulations, including adversarial-robustness tests.

title: Revealing and Classification of Deepfakes Video's Images using a Customize Convolution Neural Network Model
decisive_audit_evidence: Kaggle deepfake-video frames; the workflow extracts faces, preprocesses face crops, and compares a custom CNN with CNN/MLP-CNN classifiers.

title: DeepGuardNet: A Novel CNN Architecture for DeepFake Image Detection
decisive_audit_evidence: Celeb-DF is the reported experimental dataset; DeepGuardNet is evaluated as a real-versus-deepfake face classifier.

title: Deep fake detection and classification using error-level analysis and deep learning
decisive_audit_evidence: The primary experiment uses the Yonsei real/fake human-face image collection; ELA-derived images feed CNN feature extractors and SVM/KNN classifiers.

title: Testing human ability to detect ‘deepfake’ images of human faces
decisive_audit_evidence: The human-subject study uses 50 StyleGAN2/FFHQ-generated human faces and 50 real FFHQ faces, sampling 20 images per participant.

title: Deepfake Image Detection Using Vision Transformer Models
decisive_audit_evidence: A 40,000-image Kaggle real/deepfake collection is used to train and test the Vision Transformer; the reviewed dataset is a face-deepfake image collection.

title: MaskGAN: A Facial Fusion Algorithm for Deepfake Image Detection
decisive_audit_evidence: MaskGAN generates face-swapping images with fusion masks; those face swaps train an improved DeepLabV3+ detector for known and unknown face-tampering methods.

title: Face X-Ray for More General Face Forgery Detection
decisive_audit_evidence: Face X-Ray is evaluated on face-forgery benchmarks and unseen facial manipulation methods; its target is the blending boundary created when an altered face is composited into a face image.

title: Analysis Survey on Deepfake detection and Recognition with Convolutional Neural Networks
decisive_audit_evidence: The primary survey reviews CNN-based image/video deepfake generation and detection methods, with its technical scope organized around facial/identity deepfakes rather than general AIGI benchmarks.

title: CNN-LSTM Model for Deepfake Image Detection
decisive_audit_evidence: The primary evaluation uses FaceForensics++ and Celeb-DF video frames; the CNN extracts spatial face features and the LSTM models temporal/frame context.

title: GAN Generated Fake Human Face Image Detection
decisive_audit_evidence: The experiment detects StyleGAN3-generated fake human faces against real human-face images and reports binary face-image accuracy.

title: Detection of Deep-Morphed Deepfake Images to Make Robust Automatic Facial Recognition Systems
decisive_audit_evidence: DeepfakeTIMIT-HQ is the reported benchmark for detecting deep-morphed attacks against automatic facial-recognition systems.

title: Deepfake Image Detection Using Yolov8
decisive_audit_evidence: The primary study evaluates YOLOv8, CNN, CNN-LSTM, and ResNet on a 190,402-image real/fake human-face collection.

title: DeepFake Detection Based on Discrepancies Between Faces and Their Context
decisive_audit_evidence: FaceForensics++ and Celeb-DF-v2 are the principal benchmarks for detecting face swaps and identity manipulation from discrepancies between a face and its hair/ears/neck context.

title: CNN Detection of GAN-Generated Face Images based on Cross-Band Co-occurrences Analysis
decisive_audit_evidence: The primary experiments distinguish GAN-generated from natural face images using spatial and cross-band co-occurrence features and test robustness to geometric, filtering, and contrast post-processing.

title: Cross-Forgery Analysis of Vision Transformers and CNNs for Deepfake Image Detection
decisive_audit_evidence: Cross-forgery experiments use ForgeryNet and compare a Vision Transformer with EfficientNetV2 across face-forgery methods.

title: Deepfake Image Detection with Transfer Learning Models
decisive_audit_evidence: The primary study evaluates seven transfer-learning backbones on a 190,000-image public real/fake human-face dataset.

title: DeepFake Detection Improvement for Images Based on a Proposed Method for Local Binary Pattern of the Multiple-Channel Color Space
decisive_audit_evidence: The primary experiment uses FFHQ/face-deepfake imagery and evaluates the IR-CLBP-MC color-space representation for still-image deepfake detection.

title: DeepFake Face Image Detection based on Improved VGG Convolutional Neural Network
decisive_audit_evidence: Celeb-DF is the reported experimental dataset; NA-VGG uses SRM noise filtering and augmentation to classify forged face images.

title: SMNDNet for Multiple Types of Deepfake Image Detection
decisive_audit_evidence: The primary taxonomy and experiments cover entire-face synthesis, identity-swap face forgery, expression-swap face forgery, and attribute-manipulated face forgery (EFSF, ISFF, ESFF, and AMFF).

title: Detecting Deepfake Images Using Deep Learning Techniques and Explainable AI Methods
decisive_audit_evidence: The primary contribution applies deep classifiers and XAI explanations to deepfake face images; the reviewed task definition is replacement of one person's likeness in pictures/video.

title: An Eyes-Based Siamese Neural Network for the Detection of GAN-Generated Face Images
decisive_audit_evidence: Primary experiments compare real and GAN-generated faces under matched/unmatched generator conditions and post-processing, using inter-eye pairs as the forensic signal.

title: A Novel Deep Learning Approach for Deepfake Image Detection
decisive_audit_evidence: The reported dataset contains real and fake faces; the proposed VGG16/CNN Deepfake Predictor is compared with Xception, NASNet, MobileNet, and VGG16 transfer models.

title: Multiclass AI-Generated Deepfake Face Detection Using Patch-Wise Deep Learning Model
decisive_audit_evidence: The multiclass dataset separates real human faces, StyleGAN2-generated faces, and Stable-Diffusion-generated faces for patch-wise ViT/CNN comparison.

title: A Hybrid CNN-LSTM Approach for Precision Deepfake Image Detection Based on Transfer Learning
decisive_audit_evidence: DFDC and Ciplab are the named open-source benchmarks; the CNN-LSTM combines spatial face cues with temporal context for deepfake recognition.

title: Semantic-Aware Lightweight AI Model for Deepfake Image Detection in Online Retail Platforms
decisive_audit_evidence: The primary study uses the public Karki real/fake collection; the preserved dataset description establishes that its samples are human faces.

title: Evading Watermark based Detection of AI-Generated Content
decisive_audit_evidence: Section 7 trains and attacks HiDDeN and UDH embedded-bit watermark systems on COCO, ImageNet, and Conceptual Captions and evaluates a Stable Diffusion system carrying an intentionally embedded 136-bit watermark.
